summary: Executed targeted backend + frontend regression for CSV fidelity/import normalization, durable cover behavior, cache isolation, stats/header UI, and count regressions on preview environment.

integration_issues.issue: Directly opening another user's book shows loading splash for several seconds before 'Buch nicht gefunden.' appears (observed ~9s).

action_items: Optional UX improvement: shorten retries/time-to-empty-state for 404 book detail route.
If required by scope, add explicit UI regression for percent-only timer session end flow (page-based slider was validated).
critical_code_review_comments: CSV export/import now correctly preserves rich list fields via JSON arrays, including comma/semicolon-containing values.
Importer normalization call pattern is efficient in tested run: load_books once and taxonomy_items four times for 160-row import.
Cover persistence and custom-cover overwrite guards behaved correctly in API-level tests and browser checks.
seed_data_creation: Created isolated QA users/books via API during tests; test books were deleted where feasible. One temporary secondary account retained for UI isolation checks: cache-user2-1791060994@bookshelf.example.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Targeted suite passed: 8/8 in /app/backend/tests/test_targeted_update_semantics.py. Genuine cover checks validated dimensions/bytes/ETag with /root fixtures. UI validated cover cache reuse (no new /api/covers request on back-navigation), logout cache clearing, desktop+mobile+tablet genuine-cover screenshots, stats period dropdown behavior, header subtitle hide/show on root scroll, and existing owned search result navigation to detail.
rca of the issue: Observed delayed empty-state for unauthorized/missing book detail likely due client query retry policy before settling to !book state. Repro: login second account -> open first-account /books/{id} -> splash persists several seconds before 'Buch nicht gefunden.'
